title: Services Ceiling — exposed soffit with oval ducts, cable tray and pipes
description:
A parametric SERVICES CEILING on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A SPACE. Everything runs along the space's longest edge (Rotation turns the runs) across its bounding box less the inset: a painted soffit plate, oval ducts, a cable tray and pipes, all at stated gaps below the soffit.

THE OVAL IS BUILT FACE BY FACE, not from boxes. A quad prism only extrudes vertically, and a duct runs horizontally, so each duct is ductFacets side faces whose corners sit on the ellipse (w/2·cos a, h/2·sin a) in the (v, z) plane, plus two end caps — every facet of every duct in ONE table indexed by floor(i/N). Rectangular is the same table at four facets turned 45° and scaled by √2.

DEFAULTS are the INFRA Reception review: all ducts oval (s28), services white and complete (s18, s29), soffit at an assumed 3.6 m.

props.name: Material
props.value: painted white galvanised ducts and tray, painted soffit

params.name: Services Ceiling maths
params.expr:
_natL = 0
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_bodyL = _hostL
_bodyW = _hostW
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
svIn = inset + margin
svL = max(0.1, _hostL - 2 * svIn)
svW = max(0.1, _hostW - 2 * svIn)
svU0 = 0 - svL / 2
svU1 = svL / 2
# Oval ducts — every facet of every duct in one table; the cross-section lives in (v, z)
svNd = max(1, round(ductCount))
svOnD = ductCount >= 1
svN = ductShape == 'Oval' ? max(8, round(ductFacets)) : 4
svRot = ductShape == 'Oval' ? 0 : PI / 4
svK = ductShape == 'Oval' ? 1 : sqrt(2)
svI = arange(svNd * svN)
svD = floor(svI / svN)
svKk = svI - svD * svN
svVc = (svD - (svNd - 1) / 2) * ductSpacing + ductOffset
svZc = slabHeight - ductDrop - ductHeight / 2
svA0 = 2 * PI * svKk / svN + svRot
svA1 = svA0 + 2 * PI / svN
svV0 = svVc + svK * ductWidth / 2 * cos(svA0)
svZ0 = svZc + svK * ductHeight / 2 * sin(svA0)
svV1 = svVc + svK * ductWidth / 2 * cos(svA1)
svZ1 = svZc + svK * ductHeight / 2 * sin(svA1)
svM = rows(svI)
svUa = fill(svM, 1, svU0)
svUb = fill(svM, 1, svU1)
svSide = reshape(hcat(svUa, svV0, svZ0, svUb, svV0, svZ0, svUb, svV1, svZ1, svUa, svV1, svZ1), 4 * svM, 3)
svSideF = kron(svI, ones(4, 1))
svCapA = hcat(svUa, svV0, svZ0, svNd * svN + 2 * svD)
svCapB = hcat(svUb, svV0, svZ0, svNd * svN + 2 * svD + 1)
svLoc = vcat(hcat(svSide, svSideF), svCapA, svCapB)
svLu = _cu + col(svLoc, 0)
svLv = _cv + col(svLoc, 1)
svDucts = hcat(svLu * _ux + svLv * _vx, svLu * _uy + svLv * _vy, col(svLoc, 2), col(svLoc, 3))
Ducts3D = compress(svDucts, fill(rows(svDucts), 1, svOnD))
# Soffit plate, cable tray (base + two lips) and the ducts' plan footprints — quad prisms
svSg = soffitOn ? 1 : 0
svTg = trayOn ? 2 : 0
svTz1 = slabHeight - trayDrop
svTz0 = svTz1 - trayDepth
svTv0 = trayOffset - trayWidth / 2
svTv1 = trayOffset + trayWidth / 2
svSoffit = hcat(svU0, 0 - svW / 2, svU1, 0 - svW / 2, svU1, svW / 2, svU0, svW / 2, slabHeight - soffitThk, slabHeight, svSg)
svTray = vcat(hcat(svU0, svTv0, svU1, svTv0, svU1, svTv1, svU0, svTv1, svTz0, svTz0 + 0.003, svTg), hcat(svU0, svTv0, svU1, svTv0, svU1, svTv0 + 0.003, svU0, svTv0 + 0.003, svTz0, svTz1, svTg), hcat(svU0, svTv1 - 0.003, svU1, svTv1 - 0.003, svU1, svTv1, svU0, svTv1, svTz0, svTz1, svTg))
svPd = arange(svNd)
svPv = (svPd - (svNd - 1) / 2) * ductSpacing + ductOffset
svPn = rows(svPd)
svPg = svOnD ? 4 : 0
svDp = hcat(fill(svPn, 1, svU0), svPv - ductWidth / 2, fill(svPn, 1, svU1), svPv - ductWidth / 2, fill(svPn, 1, svU1), svPv + ductWidth / 2, fill(svPn, 1, svU0), svPv + ductWidth / 2, fill(svPn, 1, 0), fill(svPn, 1, 0.001), fill(svPn, 1, svPg))
Q = vcat(svSoffit, svTray, svDp)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Soffit3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Tray3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
TrayPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
DuctPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Pipes — axis segments, one Tube row
svNp = max(1, round(pipeCount))
svPi = arange(svNp)
svPpv = pipeOffset + (svPi - (svNp - 1) / 2) * max(0.15, 3 * pipeDia)
svPz = fill(svNp, 1, slabHeight - pipeDrop)
svPIPE = hcat(fill(svNp, 1, svU0), svPpv, svPz, fill(svNp, 1, svU1), svPpv, svPz, fill(svNp, 1, pipeDia / 2))
_t1u = _cu + col(svPIPE,0)
_t1v = _cv + col(svPIPE,1)
_t2u = _cu + col(svPIPE,3)
_t2v = _cv + col(svPIPE,4)
svPipesAll = hcat(_t1u * _ux + _t1v * _vx, _t1u * _uy + _t1v * _vy, col(svPIPE,2), _t2u * _ux + _t2v * _vx, _t2u * _uy + _t2v * _vy, col(svPIPE,5), col(svPIPE,6))
Pipes3D = compress(svPipesAll, fill(rows(svPipesAll), 1, pipeCount >= 1))
# Metrics
ductRun = svOnD ? svNd * svL : 0
ductUnderside = svZc - ductHeight / 2
trayLevel = svTz0
pipeRun = pipeCount >= 1 ? svNp * svL : 0
soffitLevel = slabHeight
serviceZoneDepth = slabHeight - min(svZc - ductHeight / 2, min(svTz0, slabHeight - pipeDrop - pipeDia / 2))
